Name: StardewAssistant
Author: genius114
Description:
[size=5][b]星露谷助手 / StardewAssistant 0.15.0[/b][/size]

作者：genius114

在游戏里调整农场、角色和日常玩法的 SMAPI 工具。所有操作使用游戏内界面，当前界面语言为简体中文；无需独立桌面助手。26 个模块可分别设置为自动兼容、开启或关闭，保存模块选择后重启游戏生效。

[size=4][b]安装与开始使用[/b][/size]

1. 安装 SMAPI 4.5.2 或更新版本。本版针对 Windows、星露谷物语 1.6.15.24356、SMAPI 4.5.2 构建；其他版本和平台未作兼容验证。
2. 解压，把整个 LocalTools.StardewAssistant 文件夹放入游戏的 Mods 文件夹。最终路径应为 Mods/LocalTools.StardewAssistant/manifest.json。
3. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏，进入单机存档，按 [b]Alt+Q[/b]，或使用 [b]Esc → 选项 → 星露谷助手[/b]。
4. 在“模块与兼容管理”选择需要的功能。数值变更通常需要点击“应用”；存档中的改变需要正常睡觉保存。

更新时先退出游戏，再用新文件覆盖旧插件文件；保留原有 config.json。本包不附带配置，不会替换用户的快捷键文件或用户蓝图。不要同时保留多个已启用的助手版本。

[size=4][b]默认快捷键[/b][/size]

• 打开助手: Alt+Q
• 农场框选编辑: Alt+E
• 构建农场、放置或移动建筑: Alt+G
• 打开原版背包: Alt+B
• 显示或隐藏 HUD: Alt+H
• 打开视野设置: Alt+V
• 放大场景: Ctrl+鼠标滚轮上
• 缩小场景、看到更多范围: Ctrl+鼠标滚轮下
• 恢复调整前的视野: Alt+R

快捷键页支持录制组合键和带修饰键的滚轮。所有快捷键均可修改或清除；普通滚轮保留原版功能。菜单、聊天、剧情或角色无法自由操作时，助手快捷键不响应。旧版的原默认键自动迁移；自定义键和主动取消的绑定保留。若新键被另一项自定义动作占用，迁移优先保留该自定义动作。迁移先在内存中生效，点击“应用”后保存。

[size=4][b]主要功能[/b][/size]

• [b]角色成长：[/b] 修改五种技能的当前等级和 10–99 级上限；查看经验、进度和职业分支，重新选择符合条件的职业。
• [b]种植：[/b] 无需浇水、生长与再生加速；框选清除并掉落、耕地、浇水、施肥或收获成熟作物。施肥消耗背包中选定肥料，未成熟作物不会被收获。
• [b]战斗和装备：[/b] 可清除的攻击、防御、暴击、移动速度与幸运加成，幸运等级加成最高 99；编辑近战武器、鞋子属性，并恢复记录的原值。
• [b]背包和戒指：[/b] 背包最高 96 格、总计最多 8 枚戒指，通过原版人物背包和宝箱界面滚动查看扩展空间。
• [b]信息查询：[/b] HUD 与经验条、好感点数和礼物收益、缺项清单、物品图鉴与附带条件的来源/概率、矿洞出口和可能出梯子的石头提示。矿洞提示不保证某块石头必出梯子。
• [b]日常便利：[/b] 商店购买数量输入与滑条、十家原版店铺的营业时段设置、时间暂停与倍率、独立日内手动存档。营业调整不移动 NPC，特殊服务仍受原版条件限制。
• [b]农场调整：[/b] 已解锁后的蘑菇/蝙蝠洞互换、原版农场类型切换、带备份的无掉落清场；绘制土地、水域、河岸、木桥和灌木，支持地形撤销/恢复。
• [b]建筑工具：[/b] 放置 24 种原版建筑、解锁唯一温室、抓取并移动已有建筑。移动保留原建筑室内、动物归属与内容，不支持移动主农舍及未适配的 Mod 建筑。
• [b]布局蓝图：[/b] JSON 布局导入/导出、全图预览、蓝图校对编辑、区域复制、局部导入、冲突列表筛选与定位、缺失建筑补建。附标准农场 4 重建模板。
• [b]视野与模块：[/b] 场景缩放 25%–400%，退出存档恢复；26 个功能模块分别开关，部分重叠功能可自动让出给已识别的其他 Mod。

布局导入处理结构化 JSON 蓝图。内置模板按一张参考图标定，不能自动识别任意图片；遮挡内容无法从图片准确恢复，不宣称像素级一比一。蓝图不复制箱内库存、机器产物、动物、室内或地图水岸。实际导入支持相同类型和尺寸的原版农场。

[size=4][b]要求与兼容范围[/b][/size]

• 必需：Stardew Valley 与 SMAPI。Harmony 使用 SMAPI 自带版本，无需另装。
• 可选：Generic Mod Config Menu，可从其列表配置助手模块；助手自身已有游戏内设置入口。
• [b]日内手动存档目前只支持助手与 SMAPI 自带的 Console Commands、Save Backup。加载其他 Mod（包括可选 GMCM）会禁用日内存档，并阻止依赖它备份的布局导入、建筑放置/移动、农场类型切换和无掉落清场。强制开启模块也不能绕过此限制。[/b] 蓝图预览/导出、普通框选编辑和其他独立模块仍可使用。
• 编辑功能面向单机主角色，不支持多人编辑。自动兼容只识别已配置的 Mod ID，不代表所有模组组合都已实测。
• 正常游戏保存会保留已执行的玩法修改。卸载助手不会自动撤销这些存档变化；需要恢复时先用相应恢复功能或备份。

停用或卸载背包/戒指扩容前，把额外格子的物品和戒指移回原版位置。模块管理页提供隐藏物品回收和恢复背包容量；放不下的物品保留原处，需腾出空格后继续回收。读取备份会恢复该备份时的整个游戏进度。

0.15.0 的发布检查包括源码审阅、Release 编译及资源/文件核对；本次快捷键改动尚未进行游戏内实测。

[size=4][b]鸣谢[/b][/size]

感谢 ConcernedApe 创作 Stardew Valley，感谢 SMAPI、Harmony、Generic Mod Config Menu 的维护者及提供反馈的玩家。本项目为非官方工具，与上述项目无官方隶属关系。

Nexus 页面：https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54664

[size=5][b]StardewAssistant 0.15.0[/b][/size]

Author: genius114

A SMAPI toolbox for adjusting your farm, character and everyday gameplay through native in-game menus. [b]The current in-game interface is Simplified Chinese.[/b] No separate desktop helper is needed. Choose Auto, On or Off for each of 26 modules, then restart the game to apply module changes.

[size=4][b]Installation and first use[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI 4.5.2 or newer. This release was built against Stardew Valley 1.6.15.24356 and SMAPI 4.5.2 on Windows; other versions and platforms have not been verified.
2. Extract the ZIP and place the entire LocalTools.StardewAssistant folder in your game's Mods directory. The final path should be Mods/LocalTools.StardewAssistant/manifest.json.
3. Launch through SMAPI, load a single-player save and press [b]Alt+Q[/b], or use [b]Esc → Options → 星露谷助手[/b].
4. Choose your modules under 模块与兼容管理. Most value changes require 应用 (Apply). Use a normal overnight save to persist changes stored with your farm.

To update, close the game and replace the plugin files while keeping your existing config.json. This package contains no preset user configuration and does not replace your hotkey file or personal blueprints. Keep only one enabled copy of the assistant.

[size=4][b]Default controls[/b][/size]

• Open assistant: Alt+Q
• Farm rectangle editor: Alt+E
• Farm builder, building placement and movement: Alt+G
• Open vanilla inventory: Alt+B
• Show or hide HUD: Alt+H
• Open zoom settings: Alt+V
• Zoom in: Ctrl+Mouse Wheel Up
• Zoom out and see a wider area: Ctrl+Mouse Wheel Down
• Restore previous zoom: Alt+R

Record keyboard combinations or a wheel direction with Ctrl, Alt or Shift on the 快捷键 (Hotkeys) page. All bindings can be changed or cleared. Plain wheel input keeps its normal behavior. Assistant shortcuts are inactive in menus, chat, events, or when the player cannot move freely. Old default bindings migrate to this preset; custom and explicitly disabled bindings are retained. Existing custom actions take priority in a collision. Migration initially applies in memory and is written to the hotkey file when you click Apply.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]

• [b]Skills and professions:[/b] edit current levels and individual level caps from 10 to 99, inspect XP and progress, and reselect eligible profession branches.
• [b]Crops:[/b] no watering, faster growth and regrowth, and rectangle tools to clear with drops, till, water, fertilize or harvest ripe crops. Fertilizing consumes the selected fertilizer from your inventory; harvesting leaves unripe crops alone.
• [b]Combat and equipment:[/b] removable attack, defense, critical, movement and luck bonuses, including a luck level bonus up to 99. Edit melee weapons and footwear, with restoration of their recorded original values.
• [b]Inventory and rings:[/b] up to 96 inventory slots and 8 total equipped rings, with scrolling integrated into vanilla inventory and chest menus.
• [b]Information:[/b] HUD and XP bars, friendship points and gift value previews, collection checklists, an item catalog with sources and conditional probabilities, and mine exit/potential ladder stone hints. A hinted stone is not a guaranteed ladder.
• [b]Daily tools:[/b] quantity input and a slider when purchasing, opening hours for ten vanilla shops, time pause/speed control and separate daytime manual saves. Shop settings do not move NPCs or waive vanilla requirements for special services.
• [b]Farm tools:[/b] switch an unlocked mushroom/bat cave, change vanilla farm type, clear the outdoor farm without drops with a backup, and draw land, water, banks, wooden bridges and bushes with terrain undo/restore.
• [b]Buildings:[/b] place 24 vanilla building types, unlock the unique greenhouse, or pick up and move an existing building while retaining its interior, animal ownership and contents. The main farmhouse and unsupported modded buildings cannot be moved.
• [b]Layout blueprints:[/b] JSON import/export, whole-farm preview, blueprint editing, area copying, partial imports, conflict filtering and click-to-locate, and creation of missing buildings. Includes a reconstructed Standard Farm 4 template.
• [b]View and modules:[/b] scene zoom from 25% to 400%, restored when leaving a save, plus 26 configurable modules. Auto mode yields selected overlapping features to recognized mods.

Layout import uses structured JSON blueprints. The included template was mapped from one reference image; it does not automatically convert arbitrary screenshots, reproduce hidden details, or promise pixel-perfect copying. Blueprints exclude container inventories, machine output, animals, interiors and map water/banks. Actual imports require matching vanilla farm type and dimensions.

[size=4][b]Requirements and compatibility[/b][/size]

• Required: Stardew Valley and SMAPI. The assistant uses SMAPI's bundled Harmony; no separate Harmony download is needed.
• Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu integration for module settings. The assistant also has its own in-game settings entry.
• [b]Daytime manual saves currently support only the assistant and SMAPI's bundled Console Commands and Save Backup mods. Loading any other mod, including optional GMCM, disables manual saves and blocks operations that require their backups: layout import, building placement/movement, farm type switching and full no-drop cleanup. Forcing a module On does not bypass this restriction.[/b] Blueprint preview/export, ordinary rectangle editing and independent modules remain available.
• Editing features are intended for the single-player main farmer. Multiplayer editing is unsupported. Automatic compatibility checks use a defined list of mod IDs and do not imply that every combination has been tested.
• Normal game saves retain gameplay edits. Removing the mod does not automatically undo saved changes; use the relevant restore feature or backup first when needed.

Before disabling or uninstalling inventory/ring expansion, move extra items and rings back into vanilla slots. The module manager includes recovery for hidden items and the original backpack capacity. Items that do not fit remain in place until space is available. Loading a backup restores the entire progress represented by that backup.

Release checks for 0.15.0 cover source review, Release compilation and resource/file inspection. The changed shortcuts have not yet been tested in a running game.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Thanks to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, the maintainers of SMAPI, Harmony and Generic Mod Config Menu, and players who provided feedback. This is an unofficial tool and is not affiliated with those projects.

Nexus page: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54664
